daily.today_energy: Your mind is moving at light speed today, Gemini. Channel that restless brilliance into something creative instead of letting it scatter everywhere. You're magnetic rn.
daily.love: Someone's been noticing your vibe. Whether you're single or coupled up, today asks you to be real about what you actually want, not what sounds good on the surface.
daily.career: Your ideas have legs today—don't let imposter syndrome keep you quiet. The energy supports you taking up more space and sharing that perspective only you have.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a little overstimulated. Ground yourself with something tactile: a walk, cold water on your face, or just sitting still for five minutes.

weekly.overview: Mercury's doing its thing this week, Gemini, and you're basically in your main character era. Communication flows like butter, ideas are hitting different, and people are actually listening. Lean into the creative momentum—your vibe is unmatched.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or floating solo, this week's giving authentic connection energy. If you've been hesitant to share something real with someone, the stars are lowkey encouraging you to take that leap. Vulnerability looks good on you right now.
weekly.career: Your natural networking superpower is amplified this week. That project you've been nervous about? Time to show up confidently. Your ideas deserve space at the table—trust your instincts and don't minimize your contributions just to keep the peace.
weekly.health: Your mind's buzzing with ideas, which is beautiful, but remember to actually ground yourself. Journaling, walking, or even just sitting outside hits different this week. Your nervous system appreciates when you give it intentional breaks from the mental chatter.
